scenarios.name: Select an overflowed tab while the ribbon is minimized to tabs

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with Tools active in tabs-only ribbon display
the narrow application window places View in the tab overflow menu
the user opens the tab overflow menu and selects View
no temporary ribbon command panel opens
the user maximizes the application window
View is visible as the active tab
the ribbon remains in tabs-only display
